acceptance: The H2O DuckDB template targets real tables or is removed.
A test verifies table and column existence for all shipped tuned templates.
context: Found 2026-10-13 by an adversarial review of DuckDB tuning templates at origin/develop 77048bfb9.
description:
## Problem
The DuckDB H2O tuned template tunes `G1_1e6_*` tables, but the H2O schema has only `trips`, so the template does nothing. No test checks that tuned-template tables exist in the benchmark schema.

## Change
- Fix the template to target `trips`, or remove it.
- Add a parametrized test asserting every table (and column) named in every shipped tuned template exists in that benchmark's schema.
